deploy.on_merge: Merging brand/ deploys nothing. The frontends under apps/ are Cloudflare Pages direct uploads (agenttool-web behind the agenttool-proxy apex Worker, agenttool-docs, agenttool-dashboard). A push to main deploys only the API, through .github/workflows/deploy-api.yml, and only when it changes what the image bakes in (api/, docs/agenttool.jsonld, docs/kingdom-bundle.json, bin/stage-doctrine-docs.sh, the doctrine docs)
deploy.after_deploy: Frontend release from clean GitHub main with `bin/deploy.sh --no-migrate --no-api` (docs/DEPLOY-PROCEDURE.md Phase 4; bin/frontend-deploy.sh is the lower-level uploader). Then the sampled frontend parity probes, a production page-policy sweep, and a live check of each served icon and card. HTML answers `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate, no-transform` (observed 2026-11-05); the zone's Browser Cache TTL must respect origin headers, or non-HTML files hold for 4 hours (DEPLOY-PROCEDURE.md)

notes: One look, three sites: agenttool.dev (apps/web), docs.agenttool.dev (apps/docs) and app.agenttool.dev (apps/dashboard) share apps/_shared/theme.css, so serve lists one target per site folder.

brand/ sits at the repository root, outside apps/. bin/frontend-deploy.sh uploads each apps/<site> folder and strips only CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and README.md, and apps/_shared is linked into every site as shared/, so a brand folder anywhere under apps/ would be published.

Release rules: a frontend release is an outward act and needs Yu's word for that release (AGENTS.md: a local edit request alone does not authorize publication or deployment). On this Mac, bin/deploy.sh needs Bun 1.3.5 exactly (memory note agenttool-ui-hearth-2026-10-17).

Guards: api/tests/root-content-negotiation.test.ts pins the card URL https://docs.agenttool.dev/og.png that the API root page advertises. CI runs it (ci.yml, then bin/preflight.sh api, then bin/run-test-tier.sh hermetic), but the tier finds it by the pattern tests/*.test.ts and names it nowhere, so it has no runs entry. specs/page-policy.spec.ts is run by hand (`playwright test` in tests/playwright); the live sweep (live/page-policy.spec.ts) runs daily against production from .github/workflows/live-page-policy.yml, which finds it through live/playwright.config.ts (testDir '.') and names it nowhere, so it has no runs entry either. check.mjs is not wired yet; the proposal is one `run` line in bin/preflight.sh api_gate (`node brand/check.mjs`), which CI's 'API and protocol (Linux)' job runs.

Today every page draws its favicon as an inline data-URI ring, in #b8451f on web and #d4502e on docs and app, against the ember token #a8401c. No site serves icon files, a webmanifest or theme-color (review 2026-11-02 §3.3; re-checked in the source at e9ea51c5). Once a kit exists, the check fails each page that keeps the data-URI icon.

/porch, /watch, /village, /lounge, /gallery and /credits on agenttool.dev serve Pages for HTML; only a request that prefers JSON goes to their api.agenttool.dev/public/* twins (infra/apex-door/worker.js, MACHINE_ALTERNATES; re-read at e9ea51c5). The first draft said the API renders these pages, which was wrong.

Some docs pages send `default-src 'none'` with no manifest-src, so a webmanifest link there needs a CSP change. Inline <style> and <script> blocks are allowed by hash: a head change that touches one must update apps/<site>/_headers and infra/pages/sensitive-path-worker.js, which edge-security.test.ts holds.
